blocks.orig: A mountain bike tour in Arusha is the perfect way to get a feel of local life.This tour takes you on your mountain bike over beautiful narrow paths and flat terrain that is relatively easy. The paths lead along local farms and extensive fields of bananas and coffee. You also cycle through a number of villages, which shows beautifully how people live here. Along the way, trees provide the necessary shade, which is especially nice in the warm season.
blocks.html: Joining a mountain bike tour in Arusha is an ideal way to experience local life. On this tour you ride your mountain bike along lovely narrow trails and fairly easy, flat ground. The route passes local farms and wide fields of bananas and coffee. You also ride through several villages, which gives you a good picture of daily life here. Trees along the route offer welcome shade, which is particularly pleasant in the warm season.
